I have been away from this practice for a few years and it is only now that I am under the care of a different GP that I have realised how bad my experience here was. I have several long term and chronic conditions and I am under several specialist consultants. Dr Vasanth would google conditions in front of me, I was asking for a referral to rheumatology because a different specialist said my symptoms were indicative of fibromyalgia. Dr Vasanth went on to say that said symptoms were not symptoms of fibromyalgia - I doubled down and said they are. We had a back and forth over this until he googled and found I was in fact correct. On another occasion, I asked if we could add in another medication I had previously been taking to be continually told no over email and/or ask my gp messages. I was at crisis point and took my father to a face to face appointment where Dr Vasanth suggested said medication. I told him that I had been asking for that medication for months, he then told my dad that I had been offered that medication and refused it - I could not believe my ears. I advocated for myself and told him I had not been offered it, he said we have a trail on emails so I invited him to look back through his emails as he was so adamant I had been offered it. He started to look and instead of apologising and telling me I was right, he went quiet and said well we can certainly add it. The amount of trauma I have suffered at his hands still lives with me to this day. I was not believed, I was gaslight beyond belief, for so long I made excuses for him but my new surgery has made me realise that the minimum we should expect from our GP is to be listened to and cared for.
